event_summary: The Russia–Ukraine conflict escalated significantly on February 24, 2022, marking a decisive turning point in the ongoing hostilities between Russia and Ukraine, which had been ongoing since the Donbas conflict began in 2014. This escalation has had a profound impact on the balance of power in Europe and the global political and economic system.
source_quote: Although the conflict erupted on February 24, 2022 – which will undoubtedly remain an important date in both Russian and Ukrainian histories – the current crisis is a continuation of the Donbas conflict in Eastern Ukraine that began in the spring of 2014.
core_sentence: Russia and Ukraine ASSAULT each other in the Russia-Ukraine conflict escalation on February 24, 2022.

event_summary: North Korea has supplied approximately 6.5 million artillery shells to Russia since the beginning of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022. This military support is part of a broader exchange where Russia provides military technology to North Korea, including technologies related to air defense systems and space development.
source_quote: Pyongyang has provided some 6.5 million shells to Russia since the start of Moscow’s full-fledged invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, in exchange for Russian military technology to manufacture its weapons.

event_summary: Russia launched the Cosmos-2553 satellite into space as a prototype for an anti-satellite weapon program. This satellite is designed to test components that could potentially carry nuclear weapons, although it did not carry any nuclear weapons at the time of its deployment.
source_quote: The testing of the 'prototype' satellite was the Cosmos-2553, launched into orbit in February 5, 2022 - nineteen days before Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine - and has been in space since, sources told the Wall Street Journal.

event_summary: Russia launched a military invasion of Ukraine, escalating tensions that had been building due to historical disputes and geopolitical factors. This invasion marked the beginning of a full-scale war between the two nations, significantly impacting regional and global stability.
source_quote: However, their relationships have been marred by growing geopolitical tensions, culminating in Russia’s audacious and wild invasion of Ukraine in Feb 2022.
